row.evidence: Qwilr's pricing page and feature table list no SSO or SCIM, and its login-security article says that besides email sign-on Qwilr supports four SSO options: Google, Microsoft, HubSpot and Salesforce.
row.notes: New row. Qwilr (proposal software) sells Starter $35/user/mo annual ($49 monthly), Growth $275/mo incl. 5 users ($55/user) and Scale $750/mo incl. 10 users ($75/user), annual only. No SAML/OIDC with a customer IdP and no SCIM were found on the pricing page, feature table, help centre (searches for scim, saml, okta, provisioning return nothing) or API reference; 'SSO' means sign-in buttons for Google, Microsoft, HubSpot and Salesforce, which this index treats as social sign-in. Users are invited and removed manually by admins. Public REST API (bearer access token) has a read-only GET /users; API usage fees apply on all plans. None by absence.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented anywhere searched; left null (absence, not a vendor statement) (status none, confidence medium).

capabilities.notes: Only GET /users is documented; it returns roles and team names for page-owner lookup.

endpoints.purpose: List users with roles and team names

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook subscriptions exist for page events; no user events seen.

audit_log_api.notes: Pricing lists a document audit trail; no audit-log API documented.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited by admins (or creators, if allowed) and removed manually; removal asks for a new page owner.
